mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the meal to the muscular tract was most worthwhile: the sequence of squeezes showed how muscle can both move and mix food.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the intestinal blood vessels was somewhat repetitive after the lining had already shown sugars crossing into surrounding tissue, though it completed the route into blood.

surprise.text: The final picture clarified that absorbed nutrients travel in plasma while oxygen rides on hemoglobin inside red cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals made each connection clear.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter. Connecting the gut and lungs through circulation made me curious how other body systems would join the model.
